newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 3.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following business stories in its Thursday edition:
NEW YORK - A steady flow of institutional sale orders knocked stock prices down on Wednesday, crushing hope that Tuesday's weak rebound marked a firming point from which stocks could rally.

WASHINGTON - Comptroller of the Currency Eugene Ludwig said that he will not take part in his agency's review of a precedent-setting application by NationsBank Corp. to enter the real estate business.

WASHINGTON - Thayer Capital Partners, a Washington investment firm, said yesterday it bought a majority stake in Software AG Americas, a Reston (Virginia) company that sells corporate database software.
WASHINGTON - When stocks tumble, executive pay often remains upright.
